name: Social Simulation Arena (SSA)
description: Can simulated societies predict what real people think, feel, and do? The field still lacks a common way to answer this question. Existing evaluations span different tasks, populations, and settings and are largely retrospective, making results difficult to compare and leaving forward generalization unclear. We propose evaluating social simulation against the real future: systems submit predictions before the results are available and are scored once the real results are released. We introduce Social Simulation Arena (SSA), a persistent prospective benchmark built around this principle. Season 0 is the first implementation of this protocol, focused on recurring public-opinion and sentiment measurements. This protocol snapshot documents the current Season 0 design and outlines the roadmap for extending the arena beyond its initial scope. This is a living paper with a growing author list. Future versions may expand both the paper and its authorship.
